unique_angle: Self-awareness is multidimensional: studies separate self-report, self-recognition, metacognitive monitoring, bodily self-processing, social or implicit effects, and neural correlates.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed self-awareness measures review + peer-reviewed cognitive-neuroscience review + peer-reviewed bodily-self review + peer-reviewed mirror-self-recognition methodology paper
